_provenance: captured-from-producer -- live GET https://api.gdeltproject.org/api/v2/doc/doc?query=stock+market+finance&mode=timelinetone&format=json&timespan=1440 on 2026-06-13. Captured 80 data points, avg_raw=0.4947, normalized_tone=0.004947.
_note: REAL GDELT 2.0 timelinetone response shape. The timeline key is a LIST OF SERIES OBJECTS, not a flat list of {date,value} points. Each series object has series (string label) and data (list of {date, value} points). The old fixture was schema-derived and had the wrong shape -- tone values were nested one level deeper than assumed, causing tone=None in production.
_bug_note: The previous fixture had timeline as [{date,value}] -- WRONG. Real shape is timeline:[{series:Average Tone, data:[{date,value},...]}]. The parser must iterate timeline[*].data[*].value, not timeline[*].value.

invariants.empty_data_is_unavailable: when timeline is [] or data arrays contain no numeric values: available=False or (available=True, tone=None) -- never a fabricated float
invariants.no_live_api_in_ci: all tests mock requests.get -- no live GDELT calls from CI
invariants.series_nesting: timeline[*] is a series object with keys series (str) and data (list). data[*] has date (str) and value (float). Parse timeline[*].data[*].value -- NOT timeline[*].value.
